description: List transactions flagged as regular (salary, rent, subscriptions, standing orders). Grouped by counterpart and direction, with detected payment interval (in months) and average amount. Use this to answer 'what subscriptions do I have?' or 'what are my fixed costs?'.

accountId.description: Cash account ID(s) to scope to; omit for all accounts

direction.description: Filter by direction: outflow (subscriptions/rent), inflow (salary), or all

perPage.description: Max transactions to scan (up to 500). Higher catches more recurrences.

name: detect_recurring_transactions
